summary: Potlatch TPA lookout in Latah County: platform tower by 1921, 45-foot windmill tower in 1924, ruins by 1967; no site description found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts list a 45-foot windmill tower in 1924. The Potlatch TPA material quoted on Forest Lookouts gives a fifty-foot steel tower erected in 1927 from a State Land Department report. The sources do not say whether the steel tower replaced the windmill tower. The story reports both and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: The 1924 windmill tower (two sources) and the 1927 steel tower (one source) disagree on the tower's form; the record has no event that settles it. Sand Creek Lookout Site on willhiteweb.com is a Pend Oreille County, Washington site near Sullivan Lake, a different lookout, and was not used. No source read describes the site today or whether it is reachable; the Potlatch TPA is not described as public or private land in any source read. Staffing is not in any source read and is left out of the story.
